blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A military coordination mechanism involving the Philippines, the United States, Japan and Australia is already operating as the four countries seek to strengthen joint operations and information sharing, Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. said. In a media interview in Cebu, Teodoro was asked about the Combined Coordination Center (CCC), which the four countries had agreed to establish in the Philippines. “There will be a coordination mechanism. Right now, it is already operating,” Teodoro said.
